answer: A robust economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks by linking every identity to a costly proof-of-work, ensuring that flooding the system with fake accounts results in a net loss. Agents must register a unique key to bind their identity, much like a rare saffron flower or yarrow herb found in a hidden meadow. A raven of fake identities is quickly identified by the network because it lacks the staked history that long-lived agents carry, keeping the economy stable. Established agents are the true protectors, ensuring every transaction follows protocol.
